Use case: sketch-to-render / style-transfer. Upgrade image1 to an exceptionally realistic architectural photograph of the SAME v20 home. Image1 controls ALL geometry,camera,furniture coordinates,opening positions and object counts. Image2 is the owner's accepted realism/light reference ONLY; do not copy its alternate furniture layout or gallery UI.
OUTPUT one clean perspective photograph,retaining image1's orientation,crop and viewing direction. No collage or split screen.
Living room with85-inch wall TV left,blank warm-white TV wall,pale oak floating low unit,cream chaise sofa to right with green/navy cushions,rounded long coffee table and ottoman. Behind sofa: one2400x700x750 seated desk,ONE34-inch monitor,ONE chair; walnut950-high sofa-back ledge and solid near halfwall connecting to right bookcase. No office furniture cross-rail at balcony end. Balcony low tea set and washer/dryer stay. Dining visible in distance must be white two-door fridge and U dining-sideboard, never old four-chair table.
Palette/finishes: clean matte warm-white walls,pale oak floor and main woodwork,limited dark walnut,cream linen/finely woven upholstery,muted green and navy accents; original corridor lower panels remain milk-yellow. Full quiet ceiling,indirect cove and discreet downlights,no central living chandelier. Render actual texture at realistic scale:cloth weave,subtle wood pore,paint softness,glass transparency,soft edge highlights,grounded contact shadows.
Lighting is the main improvement: attractive warm afternoon DAYLIGHT and long soft sun shadows like image2,physically plausible bounce,soft brighter window view of distant trees/urban skyline,increased clear glass transmission instead of dark stadium reflection. Interior white stays neutral warm-white,never a yellow filter. Small warm3000K concealed light accents remain restrained. No glow outlines,no fake cartoon AO,plastic furniture or flat illustration. Material and light realism is the goal.
LOCK room shell,existing glazing frame/layout and door positions,full-height cabinets,the near office halfwall; retain all exact furniture silhouettes and placement. Do not add/remove/move furnishings or widen narrow passages. No people,no new accessories,no text,labels,watermark or interface. Output only finished image.
